changelog:
BOSS SNAKE REWORK! The boss is now a snake that moves toward food, eats it, and grows. Position your snake to make the boss run into you — head-on or body contact damages it. Each hit removes 2 boss segments; when none remain, it dies.

YOU HAVE TO MANUALLY GO INTO YOUR FILES APP AND YOUR DOWNLOADS FOLDER TO INSTALL THIS UPDATE. Hopefully next update this won't be required. I'm working on it.

- New dedicated color picker with HSV sliders and live snake preview
- Boss hits now have their own unique damage sound
- Snake Color moved to Settings with a 3-segment preview
- Update download automatically prompts installation when complete
- Color edits persist when switching between HEAD and BODY targets
- Slider dragging no longer activates buttons on release
- Snake preview enlarged with no border and no gap between segments
